name: Home uses schema-v2 metrics and canonical 5850 strategy
setup: Import a schema-v2 save or choose Try sample view
description: Verifies Home is a domain consumer rather than a legacy constants consumer.
expected: Home renders account metrics from the normalized snapshot and the Current run build identifies the canonical 5850 Cheese strategy without a generic READY claim.

name: Pokédex sprites use icon atlas and detail opens
description: Verifies single Pokémon icons render through PokemonSprite and detail remains usable.
expected: A single icon is shown rather than an animation sheet and the Detail page opens.

name: Canonical team readiness is honest
description: Verifies the Teams screen uses canonical strategy data and separates account checks from in-run requirements.
steps: Review the six starter cards and Source-backed build notes
expected: The roster is Eternatus, Drifloon, Scatterbug, Skitty, Burmy, Nincada and status wording does not claim full build readiness from incomplete checks.

name: Fusion Lab uses canonical recipes
description: Verifies fusion recipes no longer come from legacy data.ts.
expected: Recipes show first/second source notes, purpose, source ownership, and a version-sensitive inheritance warning.

name: Architecture self-test covers all five passes
description: Verifies the local self-test spans the completed architecture.

name: Storage and reset remain isolated
description: Verifies settings expose versioned storage and account reset retains artwork cache.
steps: Choose Clear local data and confirm
expected: Account state clears and the app reports cached artwork was retained.
